steps.title: Welcome Screen
steps.desc: Discover Jharkhand — a warm, visual introduction to the land of forests, waterfalls, and rich tribal heritage.

steps.title: Onboarding
steps.desc: Choose your language (EN / HI) and set your travel preferences — adventure, culture, nature, or all of them.

steps.title: Smart Trip Planner
steps.desc: Get a personalized itinerary powered by our rule-based engine, tailored to your interests and time.

steps.title: Explore Destinations
steps.desc: Browse places on an interactive map with rich info, photos, and nearby attractions.

steps.title: Culture Hub
steps.desc: Immerse in stories, festivals, food, music, and the living tribal heritage of Jharkhand.

steps.title: Local Ecosystem
steps.desc: Connect with artisans, guides, homestays, and authentic local products.

steps.title: My Journey Dashboard
steps.desc: Track your bookings, saved trips, earned badges, and Eco Score in one place.

steps.title: Eco Score & Impact
steps.desc: See how your travel choices help nature and local communities — in real numbers.

steps.title: Johar Assistant
steps.desc: A smart FAQ assistant with predefined answers for common tourist questions.

steps.title: Verified Partners
steps.desc: Digital verification certificates for guides and homestays — trust built into every booking.

steps.title: Reviews & Feedback
steps.desc: Rate and review your experiences, and help future travelers with your insights.

steps.title: Admin Dashboard
steps.desc: Tourism analytics, visitor trends, and local impact insights for the Tourism Department.
